text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having concluded the fiercely contested spring season,
the Umamusume welcomed the arrival of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's about time to depart.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Are you feeling alright physically, Ruler?
Yeah, is your body feeling alright, Ruler?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hmm, some fatigue from the Japan Derby still lingers deep down, but... overall, I am in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "We're starting fresh from this summer, but in my mind, the Classic year is already—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I also feel like the phase is over.
choice_data_list: Phase over? Is it already finished?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, the biggest hurdle was the Nippon Derby.
After this, everyone's choice of races will likely spread out."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if we were to clash again—
it would be on a much grander stage.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's already decided.
My goal from the very beginning—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To become the ruler of the entire Twinkle Series!
It all takes place amid the struggle for that very throne.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
From now on, we must look not only at our peers,
but also at the older generation... the Senior Class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It means the time has finally come.
Naturally, there will be even stronger Umamusume in the Senior Division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To defeat higher-tier Umamusume
and stand at the pinnacle—
a more sophisticated strategy is required.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, so with that in mind, Trainer.
Help me carry in these materials.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's load the luggage onto the bus.
There are three suitcases' worth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These must be items needed for independent training.
As I moved to help out—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ruler! What is with all that luggage!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Geh, Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Practice some moderation, will you?
What's inside?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What's inside is... umm...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"It's just a little token of appreciation.
Nothing worth making a fuss over."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you can't tell me—then it's confiscated, got it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Gyaah, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!
They're board games, all of them!
I just wanted to play with Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You fool!
What do you take the sacred summer training camp for!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I didn't say all of them. The other day,
I told you to keep it to at most three, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Eek, I couldn't pick just one...
I hate how you manage aggro just enough to keep me on the edge of death...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Only three, okay? Got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove walked away.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you cut me off right in the middle of my sentence.
Well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, from here on out—
the entire Twinkle Series
becomes our game board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I shall grasp the full picture and formulate a new route!
Though before that—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We have to choose three.
Which ones do you want?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Under the blazing sun, we sorted through a massive pile of board games.
